name: BD-SHS: Benchmark Dataset for Online Bangla Hate Speech in Social Contexts
description: BD-SHS is a large benchmark dataset for learning to detect online Bangla hate speech across various social contexts. It contains over 50,200 manually annotated social media comments crawled from Facebook and YouTube, featuring hierarchical annotations for hate speech detection (binary), target detection (individual, male, female, group), and hate type detection (slander, religion, gender, call to violence).
